opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (£750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored award); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members. Scheme A: undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference; supervisors providing support letters must be current GS members.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics, with three streams: (A) GS/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences. Covers travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a member for at least one year. Supervisors must be GS members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques. Covers travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration/tuition fees.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a member for at least one year. Supervisors must be GS members.
opportunities.summary: Funded by income from the journal Heredity, covering travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects whose results would typically be suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs (UK-based, budget/economy class).

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of age of the person they care for; priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: An award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend a Society meeting or event, used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance. Awarded competitively and claimed in arrears on production of receipts.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: From a few hundred pounds for a specific lecture to several thousand pounds for major sponsorship; major sponsorship levels over the last 12 months between £1,000 and £2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members organising genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Society; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of one-off genetics-themed meetings with an ad hoc organising committee, possibly partly sponsored by another society. Funds are for organising the meeting, not attending it, and should include a Carer's Award.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding (SIG)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities running regular series of meetings. Funds may support speaker travel, accommodation, publicity or other direct meeting costs.
